 Description: This visa is for invited workers and New Zealand citizens with skills we need, to live and work permanently anywhere in Australia.
 Alert: 189 visa landing page (updated 22/06/2023 3:41:18 PM)
 The Skilled Independent (subclass 189) (New Zealand stream) visa is currently closed to new applications and will permanently close to new applications on 1 July 2023. For more information see Recent changes.​

+Alert: 189 visa landing page banner (updated 1/09/2026 10:36:36 AM)
+We prioritise applications for the Skilled – Independent (subclass 189) visa (Points-tested stream) underMinisterial Direction No. 119. We are currently processing applications that were lodged in:As received – Australian law enforcement or defence interests.June 2026 – Construction, healthcare and teaching occupations from applicants who were in Australia when they applied.January 2026 – All other applications from applicants who were in Australia when they applied.November 2025 – All other applications from applicants who were outside Australia when they applied.​
